title: Two Types of Tertiarization: Household Demand, Production Networks, and the Rise of Services
abstract: arXiv:2608.06584v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I measure whether the rise of services is ultimately supported by household consumption or by non-household demand through production networks, investment, exports, and government. Using harmonized input-output tables for 76 economies over 1995-2022, I attribute service value added to its ultimate domestic final-demand category and measure the household orientation of each service economy in both levels and growth. The conventional service share does not reveal the type: it is negatively correlated with household orientation, and only about four in ten tertiarization episodes are majority-household. Among the 65 economies whose service share rose over 1995-2018, 77 percent became less household-oriented; the share is 75 percent under a two-percentage-point material-change threshold. translated_title: 两种类型的服务业化：家庭需求、生产网络与服务业的兴起
translated_abstract: 本文衡量服务业的兴起最终究竟是由家庭消费所支撑，还是由经由生产网络、投资、出口和政府产生的非家庭需求所支撑。利用1995-2022年间76个经济体的统一投入产出表，作者将服务业增加值归因于其最终的国内最终需求类别，并从水平和增长两个维度衡量各经济体的家庭导向程度。研究发现，传统的服务业份额指标无法揭示服务业化的类型：它与家庭导向呈负相关，仅有约四成的服务业化进程以家庭需求为主导。在1995-2018年间服务业份额上升的65个经济体中，77%的经济体家庭导向程度下降；在设定两个百分点的实质性变化阈值下，该比例为75%。然而，随着收入水平的提高，由家庭需求支撑的生产变得更加服务密集，这是因为家庭在总体经济中的地位下降得更快。单一类型的基准……
tldr: 本文通过76个经济体1995-2022年的投入产出数据，将服务业化区分为家庭消费驱动与非家庭需求（生产网络、投资、出口、政府）驱动两种类型，发现大多数经济体服务业份额上升的同时家庭导向反而减弱，因此传统服务业份额指标无法反映服务业化的真实驱动类型。
en_tdlr: This paper distinguishes two types of tertiarization—household-driven versus non-household demand-driven (through production networks, investment, exports, and government)—and, using input-output data for 76 economies over 1995-2022, shows that rising service shares are typically accompanied by declining household orientation, so conventional service share measures fail to reveal the true type of tertiarization.
